description: This PHP source file defines the ThemeHookCollectorPass class, which implements the CompilerPassInterface for Drupal. It collects, processes, and registers hook implementations for themes, handling both class-based and procedural hooks, and manages hook-related data within the dependency injection container.

classes.name: ThemeHookCollectorPass
classes.description: A class that collects and registers hook implementations for Drupal themes, handling class-based and procedural hooks, and managing hook data within the dependency injection container.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Processes the container to collect all hook implementations and writes them to the container.

methods.name: writeToContainer
methods.description: Writes collected hook definitions and data into the container as parameters.

methods.name: calculateImplementations
methods.description: Calculates and returns ordered hook implementations, storing preprocess suggestions.

methods.name: collectAllHookImplementations
methods.description: Collects all hook implementations from themes and returns a collector instance.

methods.name: getThemeListPattern
methods.description: Generates a regex pattern to match hooks for a list of themes.

methods.name: collectThemeHookImplementations
methods.description: Collects hook implementations from theme files, handling class-based and procedural hooks.

methods.name: getFilteredImplementations
methods.description: Returns hook implementations with removals applied.

methods.name: registerHookServices
methods.description: Registers hook implementation services in the container.

methods.name: filterIterator
methods.description: Filters files during directory iteration to include relevant PHP and theme files.

methods.name: checkInvalidHookParametersInThemes
methods.description: Checks for invalid hook parameters in theme classes and throws exceptions if found.

methods.name: getAttributeInstances
methods.description: Retrieves attribute instances from class and method reflections.
